title: A consequence-inert artificial-life research track (SymbioSoup) that starts by reproducing CuBFF exactly
statement: The founder attached two AI-written research reports without other words on 2026-11-22: a ChatGPT report recommending two deliberately separated systems (an experimental SymbioSoup artificial-life track and the conventional governed UNIIMENTE runtime) and a Gemini specification for a five-layer 'emergent alien intelligence'. Both put the same first step first: reproduce the canonical Computational Life / CuBFF phenomenon and build a trusted measurement kernel before inventing.
exact_source_excerpt: The objective is not to build the Egregore. It is to reproduce the canonical phenomena and establish a trusted measurement kernel.
changed_axis: none: research capability in developmental/ only; no authority, consequence or runtime path changes.
intended_effect: UNIIMENTE gains a verified library of mechanisms whose causal contribution (replication, composite individuality, ecological agency, predictive modelling, cooperation, functional modularity) has been experimentally isolated; only mechanisms that beat conventional alternatives are proposed for the governed architecture (the report's six-month success condition, compiled to an effect).
executable_interpretation: Stage A, first step: developmental/bff.py is a byte-exact Python reference of CuBFF bff_noheads (interpreter, SplitMix64 initialisation, 2^-12 per-byte mutation before execution, Fisher-Yates pairing, CheckSelfRep), read from the CuBFF source at f212e849, with tests and bounded emergence runs. Metaphor/literal split (INTENT-0030): 'symbiogenesis', 'metabolism', 'organs', 'alien intelligence' are mechanism-discovery prompts; the literal requirement is only what each stage gate measures. Evolved bytes are data to the host: never code, paths, commands or messages.
consequence_class: read_only (simulation inside the process; no external effect)
constitutional_constraints: no evolved artifact gains execution authority or leaves the VM as code
no self-modifying production code; generated or evolved capability never self-attaches or self-promotes
stage gates authorize nothing; graduation of any mechanism is a founder decision
AI-written reports are leads; their claims are verified or labelled unverified
success_evidence: tests/unit/test_developmental_bff_differential.py (re-checks the recorded CuBFF output without the binary)

tests/evidence/bff-reference-2026-11-22/differential/ (2026-11-22: CuBFF f212e849 built with make CUDA=0, g++ 13.3.0; 12 of 12 soup checkpoints byte-identical for seeds 0 and 1 at 1,024 programs through 321 epochs; 800 of 800 tapes identical in final bytes and operation count; 114 of 114 CheckSelfRep scores identical, including full replicators scoring 64)
failure_evidence: Stage A falsification gate (report p.23): differential mismatch with CuBFF on any deterministic tape, or an emergence distribution grossly incompatible with ~40% within 16k epochs at 131,072 programs
dependencies: differential test against the CuBFF binary: DONE 2026-11-22, after the founder asked for it in this session's chat ('build CuBFF with make CUDA=0 and run the differential test'); no mismatch was found, so developmental/bff.py was not changed

canonical-scale reproduction (131,072 programs, 16,000 epochs, 50-100 seeds): run with CuBFF itself on CPU, see tests/evidence/bff-reference-2026-11-22/differential/README.md for the seeds completed; 50-100 seeds were not reached
conflicts: Gemini specification: self-rewriting agent code and a Darwin Gödel Machine archive conflict with the authority rules unless confined to a consequence-inert sandbox with external evaluators; preserved as leads
both reports cite 2026 arXiv work (2607.01483, 2607.09211, 2609.10817, 2609.36126) that could not be fetched here (arxiv.org refused by the egress proxy): unverified
next_review_trigger: more Stage A scale seeds (to the report's 50-100), or a Stage A gate decision by the founder
